name: Ribbon Cake (Second Recipe)
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ½ teaspoon each cinnamon, cloves, allspice and nutmeg

ingredients.name: ½ cup each raisins and currants
ingredients.originalText: ½ cup each raisins and currants

instructions.text: Dissolve the soda in the milk
Mix the cream tartar in the flour
Beat the eggs, sugar and butter well together
Take 1 cup of this mixture, 1 teaspoon molasses, ½ teaspoon each cinnamon, cloves, allspice and nutmeg, ½ cup each raisins and currants
Dredge the raisins and currants with flour, mix with the molasses and spices into the cup batter taken from the first
Bake in oblong tins in 3 layers, put together with jelly, the dark part between the light parts

source.originalInstructions:
1. Dissolve the soda in the milk
2. Mix the cream tartar in the flour
3. Beat the eggs, sugar and butter well together
4. Add the milk and flour
5. Take 1 cup of this mixture, 1 teaspoon molasses, ½ teaspoon each cinnamon, cloves, allspice and nutmeg, ½ cup each raisins and currants
6. Dredge the raisins and currants with flour, mix with the molasses and spices into the cup batter taken from the first
7. Bake in oblong tins in 3 layers, put together with jelly, the dark part between the light parts
